name: E.S.C.A.P.E.
summary:
E.S.C.A.P.E. is a psychological survival horror game set in an abandoned research facility. With no weapons available, play centres on stealth and evasion: hiding in lockers, crouching, moving quietly and managing a failing flashlight while a creature that hunts by sound searches the corridors.

Progress comes from exploring laboratories, security rooms, underground tunnels, ventilation shafts and hospital wards in search of keys, tools, generators and access codes, with documents and recordings gradually revealing the purpose of the facility's experiments.
